title: Ensuring Safety of Persons at Places of Worship, Schools, Hospitals and Other Institutions
what_it_is: Ensuring Safety of Persons at Places of Worship, Schools, Hospitals and Other Institutions

sections.label: Counter-terrorism collaboration with community partners
sections.summary: MHA works with religious organisations, schools and hospitals on counter-terrorism measures, including drills, security standards and readiness exercises.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: The Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) has been collaborating with community partners, which includes religious organisations, schools and hospitals, to enhance our ability to prevent, detect and respond to terror attacks.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: For more information on the efforts that we have made to enhance safety at places of worship and to engage the public, Members may refer to MHA’s responses to similar Parliamentary Questions on 7 January 2025.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Then, I had shared that MHA works closely with community and religious organisations, including places of worship, through the Ministry of Culture, Community and Youth’s (MCCY's) Crisis Preparedness for Religious Organisations programme, where religious organisations participate in security self-assessments, develop contingency plans and attend counter-terrorism seminars to understand the threat better.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: All schools have a School Emergency Structure, helmed by the Principal, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), to help staff and students deal with, respond to and recover from emergencies, including a terror attack.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Besides annual lockdown drills, schools also conduct regular exercises involving the Police and the Singapore Civil Defence Force (SCDF).

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: The Ministry of Health (MOH) continually enhances the security resilience of the healthcare sector through various measures.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: These include aligning security standards across healthcare institutions and conducting regular readiness exercises with the Police and SCDF for public acute hospitals, where they are assessed on their measures to secure their facilities while responding to a mass casualty incident.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: When there is a heightened security situation, the Police will step up security measures, such as increasing the frequency of patrols.

sections.label: SGSecure movement readiness
sections.summary: MHA will continue working with religious organisations, public institutions and the community through SGSecure to strengthen readiness to terror attacks.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Through the SGSecure movement, MHA will continue to work with religious organisations, public institutions and the community at large to strengthen our readiness to terror attacks.
